title: Ellipsis sometimes not being rendered for RTL text
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.dev (76fa7b291455a8ba24c50005072ebdb58f8a5984)

### Steps to reproduce

Create a Label:

- Set some text
- Enable `clip_text`
- Set `text_overrun_behavior` to Ellipsis
- Set `text_direction` to Right-to-Left
- Resize the Label
